metadata.scenario: A dissatisfied customer calls to complain about a leaking shower after a recent plumbing service. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Harold Gonzalez. I’m calling because I have a complaint about the recent plumbing service. I'm sorry to hear that, Harold. Can you tell me what happened? Well, ever since the plumbing was done, the shower has been leaking. It's getting really frustrating. That sounds really inconvenient. When did you first notice the leak? I noticed it the day after the plumbing service was completed. It's been leaking ever since. I apologize for the issue you're facing. Has anyone from our team reached out to you about this? No, no one has contacted me. I had to reach out myself. I completely understand your frustration. Let me take down some details to escalate this issue. Okay, please do. It's really becoming a hassle for us. Can I have the date of the plumbing service and the name of the technician who came out? The service was done last Thursday, and the technician was Marco. Thank you for that information, Harold. I'll make sure to follow up on this right away. I’d appreciate it if you could resolve this as soon as possible. Absolutely, I’ll prioritize this. Would you also like to schedule a follow-up visit with a new technician? Yes, that would be great. I just want this fixed. I can arrange that. Would you prefer someone who speaks Spanish? Yes, that would be ideal. My wife prefers it too. Noted. I’ll ensure we send a Spanish-speaking technician for the follow-up. Thank you. I hope this gets resolved soon. I’ll also check the status of your current care plan while I’m at it. That would be helpful, thanks. I’ll have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, reach out to discuss any adjustments needed. Okay, I appreciate that. Is there anything else you’d like to address while I have you on the line? No, that's all for now. Just fix the shower, please! I understand completely, Harold. Thank you for your patience and for bringing this to our attention. Thank you, Margaret. I hope to hear back soon. You will. Have a great day, Harold! You too, bye. Goodbye.
